refined_question: Let Ω ⊂ C^n be a weakly pseudoconvex domain of finite type. Characterize the boundary sets E ⊂ ∂Ω that are peak sets for the natural domain algebra of functions holomorphic on Ω and continuous on Ω-bar; that is, determine exactly which closed boundary sets E admit a function f, holomorphic on Ω and continuous on Ω-bar, such that f = 1 on E and |f| < 1 on Ω-bar \ E. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/pdf/math/9509202))
justification: Section 5 places the question in the function theory of domains in C^n, and Section 5.4 isolates the subtopic "Peak Points and Peak Sets." Within that subsection, Problem 5.4.2 is exactly your draft question, while nearby Problem 5.4.1 asks the corresponding pointwise question for finite-type pseudoconvex domains. This shows that the intended target is the narrow classification of peak sets in that same finite-type weakly pseudoconvex context, not a broader survey question about all peak phenomena on pseudoconvex domains. Because the paper gives the problem only in compressed list form and supplies no local notation or definitions around 5.4, the only legitimate sharpening is to make explicit the ambient space, the boundary-set nature of the objects classified, and the peak-function condition, without importing stronger hypotheses not stated there. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/pdf/math/9509202))
